# Kalaratri v0 — log anomaly detection on real Hadoop logs

**LogHub HDFS_v1** (Zenodo 8196385): 575,061 HDFS blocks, 2.93% anomalous. Split **by time**: train 345,036, threshold on 115,012, test on the last 115,013 — never shuffled. All three detectors scored on the same test blocks.

| pca (Xu et al. 2009) | 0.766 | 0.996 | 0.866 | 0.0045 |
| unseen-template rule | 1.000 | 0.432 | 0.604 | 0.0000 |

## How to read this

- Published HDFS results often split blocks at random and report F1 near 0.99; a time split is harder and closer to deployment, so lower numbers here are expected, not a regression.
